title: The Last Knight: how to play
sections: Chase the inventor of the crossbow through five eras (a castle, the Viking seas, a Roman aqueduct, a Dutch polder and his tower) and beat him in a boss fight at the top of his tower.
Drag on the left half of the screen to run. JUMP jumps; SWORD swings your sword. On a PC: arrows to run, SPACE or up to jump, X or J to swing.

The red dots at the top are your health: every hit takes one. With no health left you lose a life and start again at the last checkpoint flag with full health. When you run out of lives the game is over. Easy gives 4 lives and 4 health, Normal 3 and 3, Hard 2 lives and faster enemies that shoot more often.

Swing at enemies, or jump on top of them: a stomp scores half again as many points. Most enemies can be stomped, but watch out for Roman legionaries: their shield blocks from the front, so get behind them. Dutch cyclists always have right of way: jump over them.
Swing your sword just as a crossbow bolt or a thrown axe reaches you to knock it back. You'll need this against the inventor himself: parry his bolts and hit him while he reloads.
Touch a flag to make it your checkpoint. The game saves at the start of every level and before the boss, so Continue on the start screen brings you back there.
Enemies and ducats (coins) give points. Finishing a level fast gives a time bonus, and every life you have left at the end is worth 500 points.
